slot-10d57425-0aac-42fd-a2ca-9bd7b01aff5.quote_span: In the House, Democrat Rep. Chris Pappas voted against President Donald Trump’s One Big Beautiful Bill Act in 2025, and he voted for higher taxes or against lower taxes three times as a state legislator more than two decades ago.
slot-10d57425-0aac-42fd-a2ca-9bd7b01aff5.speaker: outlet's own
slot-10d57425-0aac-42fd-a2ca-9bd7b01aff5.checkable_against: House roll-call records and New Hampshire legislative roll-call records

slot-e42653bf-05a4-4c03-ae63-c664fc5c17c.quote_span: The list cites 16 distinct congressional bills but counts an average of more than three procedural votes per bill in its overall tally.

slot-496fb24f-5e0b-4363-9f17-474c10e51ee.quote_span: Among other votes Sununu’s campaign cited were votes on the HEROES Act, a $3 trillion COVID-19 relief measure proposed in 2020 that Pappas voted for but didn’t become law.

slot-1fad078e-2785-473e-a30d-2cec1466d76.quote_span: Another law on the list that Pappas voted for, the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, can be fairly described as a tax-focused measure.
